title: Chapter 908
paragraphs: Chapter 908
Episode 228. Siege of Grosh Castle (4)
Reila nodded as if it wasn't surprising at all.
"Lord Jito enjoys all kinds of pain. Inflicting pain on his loyal subordinates must also be a part of his pleasure."
"So, you are prepared to go to any length, whether it's killing enemies for Jito or falling into pain?"
"That's correct. All of us, including myself, exist solely for Lord Jito."
Jito has never explained his 'ultimate goal' to his subordinates.
Therefore, most of the devils, including the Devil King, only knew that the purpose of this invasion was to rule over humans through pain.
Through pain, a new order would replace the Sun God, and everyone would enjoy their rightful fate accordingly.
However, what Kelliac had learned, the world Jito wanted, was even more horrifying.
"Don't you feel pity for your life?"
"You keep making rude remarks. But I don't intend to kill a human who has a witch behind him, so you should leave."
Just as Reila was about to call her subordinates to expel Kelliac, flames suddenly filled his eyes. Misinterpreting it as an attack, Reila unsheathed her sword.
However, for some reason, her body wouldn't move when she met the fiery eyes of Kelliac.
Just like Dailus, who died on the front lines of Grosh Castle a moment ago, images she couldn't comprehend were flashing in her mind. Memories that she had forgotten.
"Damn... what did you do!"
Her mind was extremely confused, and she couldn't properly wield her sword. Reila, clutching her head, was trembling.
"You should understand that I'm trying to help you. This is a power I call the Fire of Awakening; aren't you having some thoughts?"
"What the hell is this...!"
"You probably know better than me. But guessing the content wouldn't be that difficult. Lost relatives, friends, lovers... or something else that was precious to you, must be remembered."
Blood tears were flowing from Reila's eyes.
The sight of the people she loved being torn apart by Jito, and the horrendous torture that made her forget about it, was all piercing her consciousness as if it happened yesterday.
Sometimes, the brainwashing of Jito would work again, amplifying her anger towards Kelliac. But unlike Dailus, she was desperately struggling to hold onto the newly emerged memories.
A moment later, the fire in Kelliac's eyes went out.
"Huh, ha...!"
Reila lifted her head, gasping for breath.
Kelliac too was panting, drenched in sweat from his entire body. Using the Fire of Awakening was also a great risk for him.
Furthermore, even if he risked keeping the Fire of Awakening alive, it was impossible to completely eradicate Jito's brainwashing at its roots. It was something not even the witch Helluram could do.

"...What you saw just now was just a fraction of it. Only a part of the forgotten memories has surfaced. You probably feel it the most without me having to explain it. Simply put, you've been brainwashed by Jito all this time."
She couldn't believe it.
Reila couldn't bring herself to say that. Just as those who saw the Seal of Fire felt absolute trust, so was the Fire of Awakening.
"Even now, when the Fire of Awakening has momentarily pushed away Jito's powers, it's the same. If I don't continue to follow up, you'll soon turn back into a loyal dog to Jito."
"Hah."
"In a way, it might be better not to fully confirm all the truths you've forgotten. Seeing you suffering so much just from this, I think your mind could completely collapse if everything comes back."
"Kelliac Zipfel... how did you discover the existence of my erased memories, which even I didn't know?"
"The answer to that depends on what kind of relationship you and I will have in the future. I'll ask you again, Reila Belgasium. Do you still think it's right to pledge loyalty to Jito?"
There was a moment of silence.
"...What do you want from me?"
"I want you to fight with me, not Jito, in the future."
"Do you intend to overthrow Lord Jito, no, Jito... and conquer this demon world?"

"I have no interest in ruling the demon world. For me, the demon world is nothing more than a means to regain my clan. But once I regain my clan, there will need to be a ruler to govern the demon world. Not a monster like Jito, but a person who deserves to be called a king of a world."
Clank...
Kelliac filled the tea cup.
"I think that person should be your older brother, Faelito Belgasium. What do you think?"
"...Does Lord Faelito also know this? Is he also under the state of brainwashing?"

“You're asking the obvious. Faelito is just like you a moment ago. He doesn’t know he's been brainwashed, and he doesn’t know why he’s so blindly loyal to Zito. Even though, until he was brainwashed, he was the most fiercely resistant person to Zito in the whole demon world."
"Grrrr!"
Suddenly, Layla groaned in terrible pain that swept through her body.

"Ah, it seems Zito's energy is already trying to eat your awakened mind again. As I said before, once you've seen the flame of awakening, such pain will come incessantly for some time. Is it too painful?"
Layla twisted and turned for several minutes without answering.

"It's a dumb question I just asked. But if you really want to take revenge on Zito, you have to keep overcoming that pain. It means you need determination. If you're afraid of the pain and accept the mind-invading brainwashing again, you'll feel better. But you'll also lose the memories you've regained."
"I have no thought of getting comfortable. This kind of pain... I can bear it. I won't fight for Zito anymore."
"Good attitude. Then, will you fight with me?"

"Since you've told me the truth, I will repay that debt. But that doesn't mean I will pledge complete loyalty to you. From now on, I will fight for the Bellagashim family, for Faelito, for the demon world, and for myself."
"Great answer. If you like me, pledge your loyalty, you won't regret it. However, with such an answer, I can't confirm your will."
"What should I do?"
"Visit Dokmaseong once every two weeks."
"Dokmaseong?"
"I'm staying in Dokmaseong, and every time you visit, I'll light up the flame of awakening. And from some point, if you don't visit me, I'll understand you've become Zito's dog again."
"That won't happen. Thank you... for making me realize who my enemy is."
Despite the heart-wrenching events that came to mind, Layla was quickly regaining her senses.
Because she knew she would become Zito's prey again if she wasn't calm for even a moment.
"But Dokmaseong, it seems you've already captured Ragal Pun. Was that idiot also in a brainwashed state like me?"

"Because he was ruined by brainwashing, Ragal Pun is originally a very outstanding person. So, in the future, when you deal with Ragal, be courteous. He started awakening earlier than you and is enduring more pain."
"He's enduring more pain than me... that Ragal...?"

Of course, Ragal hasn't. Kelriak simply won him over without the flame of awakening. And whether Ragal was really an outstanding person before brainwashing, Kelriak doesn't really know. Kelriak was just simply raising Ragal's loyalty in a simple way.

Leila nodded thoughtfully as she recalled Ragal's crass and shallow behaviors. She hadn't committed to loyalty to Kellyak yet, but since Kellyak recognized Ragal, there was no need to disregard him as before.
"I understand. I'll be careful. It's really surprising... Kellyak, it seems like you've obtained immortality. I can't believe that you were of such high status."
"I'll be on my way then. If you endure the pain and find me again in two weeks, I'll tell you more details. By then, I'll really be able to trust your will."
"Alright. I'll head to Dokmaseong in two weeks."
At the sea, which was the first line of defense in the demon world.
Whoooosh...!

Every time the sea breeze blew, the poisonous fog left by Ragal and the ash of the demon corpses cast a large shadow on the sea. The Groshay Fortress had abandoned the first line of defense and was no longer sending troops.

Due to the poisonous fog, the Allied Forces were also not advancing. While it was possible for superhumans, including Jin, to remove the fog and continue advancing, finding records about Ragal was the priority. After all, the other three lines of defense were still in combat with the remaining large forces.
"Valeria, do you want to rest a bit before we continue?"
Inside the protective shield created by Murakan, blue windows were constantly being refreshed. Valeria had been going through the battlefield records for already six hours.
"It's okay, Jin. There are so many records of the deceased on the battlefield that it's just cumbersome to sift through, but it's not very tiring."
Jin carefully wiped the sweat from Valeria's forehead.
<...The owner of Dokmaseong, Ragal Pun, joins the battlefield in response to the request for support from Sakiel Groshay, the head of the Demon World's total recording agency.>
<However, Ragal Pun does not fight with all his strength, following the orders of Kellyak Zipel.>
After a while, the only significant content in the records about Ragal that they found was those two lines.
But that was enough to confirm the collusion between Kellyak and Ragal.
"Hoo, all the other records are just descriptions of the battle situation. But it's worthwhile since the collusion between Kellyak Zipel and Ragal has been clearly revealed."
Jin nodded.

"Just as Bisepts predicted. Kellyak Zipel and Ragal Pun... According to Bisepts, Ragal Pun was definitely brainwashed by Bisepts just like the others. But he prioritized Kellyak's orders over defending the Groshay Fortress, which means Kellyak has the ability to break or at least weaken Zito's brainwashing."
[Kid, is it possible that Kellyak and Zito are in cahoots?]

"If that were the case, if only Ragal had fought properly, their first line of defense wouldn't have been annihilated like this. If Kellyak was loyal to Zito and the Demon World, Ragal would have fought with all his might."
After a moment of thought, Jin added.
"It seems like there's a crack forming within the Demon World, probably due to Kellyak Zipel."
